Christian Israel Tours

Frequently asked questions

  • Absolutely. Every year, Israel welcomes many thousands of tourists, and we specifically choose destinations that have no government or safety restrictions.

  • The ideal duration of a trip to Israel is between 7 and 14 nights. However, it is also common for visitors to come for 5 nights, allowing for 3 days of touring.

  • During Israeli winter (December-March), some regions experience cold temperatures, while others may have milder days. It is advisable to pack winter clothing while keeping options for lighter attire.

  • During the summer months (June-September), the weather can be scorching hot. It is recommended to wear lightweight and breathable clothing that will keep you comfortable in the heat. Additionally, when visiting holy places, remember to dress modestly and ensure appropriate coverage.

  • During the transitional seasons of fall (September-December) and spring (March-June), the weather can vary from chilly to warm. It is recommended to bring clothing that can adapt to both conditions.

  • Bethlehem welcomes thousands of tourists daily, and based on our extensive experience, it maintains the same level of safety as other destinations in Israel.

  • No, a PCR test is not required for entry into Israel.
